question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing center midfielder, and Eve is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) right back
(C) fullback
(D) center midfielder
(E) right winger
solution:
Positions are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: striker, right back, fullback, center midfielder, right winger.
1. Claire and Alice swap: fullback, right back, striker, center midfielder, right winger.
2. Bob and Eve swap: fullback, right winger, striker, center midfielder, right back.
3. Alice and Claire swap: striker, right winger, fullback, center midfielder, right back.
4. Bob and Alice swap: right winger, striker, fullback, center midfielder, right back.
5. Alice and Claire swap: fullback, striker, right winger, center midfielder, right back.
Eve is playing right back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
